description: This file defines the AppTheme class, which provides configuration for light and dark application themes using Flutter's Material 3 theming system. It sets color schemes based on a seed color and customizes UI component themes such as AppBar, FloatingActionButton, InputDecoration, and Card.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate light and dark themes for a Flutter application, emphasizing Material 3 and accessible contrast.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for light mode, utilizing Material 3 and a seed color for color schemes, with customized component themes.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for dark mode, utilizing Material 3 and a seed color for high-contrast color schemes, with customized component themes.
